title: Remediate development nanoid advisory
summary: Clears the high-severity development-only nanoid advisory by resolving the Vite/PostCSS transitive dependency to nanoid 3.3.18 without changing application runtime behavior.
changes: Updated package-lock.json so the development dependency graph resolves nanoid 3.3.18 instead of the affected 3.3.16 release under PostCSS.
version_rationale: A backward-compatible patch release remediating GHSA-2v37-7h3g-55p8 in the development dependency graph without changing production packages or application behavior.
validation: npm ci, npm audit (full and omit=dev), npm run test:frontend, npm run build, focused release/changelog/health contract tests, composer test, and myapes:changelog-validate against origin/main.
known_limitations: This patch does not change application features, authorization, or data. No production LDAP or deploy is authorized by this release.
rollback: Revert this patch record, VERSION, runtime manifest version, and package-lock.json nanoid resolution. No database rollback is needed.
provenance: Defined by the development nanoid advisory remediation for MyAPES Account issue #45.
